landing.title: Northwind Supply — everyday objects, built to be kept
landing.description: The public storefront for Northwind Supply. Browse the catalogue, then continue to the shop.

shop.title: Northwind Shop
shop.description: Browse the catalogue, manage your cart and review your orders.

shell.tagline: Northwind Supply — everyday objects, built to be kept.

hero.title: Everyday objects, built to be kept.
hero.lede: Northwind Supply makes a small, opinionated catalogue: things you reach for daily and expect to still have in ten years. No endless scroll, no filler.

catalogue.title: This season’s picks
catalogue.description: A curated slice of the catalogue - the full feed lives in the shop.

repairable.title: Repairable by design
repairable.copy: Every item ships with the parts and the manual to fix it.

onePrice.title: One price, no games
onePrice.copy: The number you see is the number you pay — no timers, no dark patterns.

carbonNeutral.title: Carbon-neutral delivery
carbonNeutral.copy: Offset on every parcel, measured and reported each quarter.

browse.title: Browse
browse.addRefused: The order service refused the add — sign in first, or try again once it is reachable.

signedOut.title: Sign in to browse
signedOut.description: The catalogue is read through your session — the order service only answers it for a signed-in shopper. Sign in on your account, then reload.

unreachable.title: No products to show
unreachable.description: The catalogue is served by the order API at {url}. It is not reachable right now ({reason}). Start the order service, or point NEXT_PUBLIC_ORDER_API_URL at a running one, then reload.

empty.title: The catalogue is empty
empty.description: The order service answered, but it has no products yet.

cart.title: Cart
cart.description: What you are about to order.
cart.clearRefused: The order service refused the clear — your cart is unchanged.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.description: Items you add while browsing will appear here.

signedOut.title: Sign in to see your cart
signedOut.description: Your cart lives on the order service under your session. Sign in on your account, then reload.

unreachable.title: Cart unavailable
unreachable.description: The cart is served by the order API at {url}. It is not reachable right now ({reason}).

confirmed.title: Order confirmed
confirmed.replayedNote: This confirmation was already sent — the order service returned the same order instead of writing a second one.

refused.cartEmpty: The order service refused: your cart is empty. Nothing was placed and nothing changed.
refused.insufficientStock: The order service refused: {product} has {available} in stock and you asked for {requested}. Nothing was placed — your cart is unchanged.
refused.unknownProduct: The order service refused: {productId} is not a product it sells. Nothing was placed — your cart is unchanged.
refused.sessionInvalid: The order service refused: your session is not live. Sign in on your account, then confirm.
refused.generic: The order service refused: {reason}. Nothing was placed.

empty.title: Nothing to check out yet
empty.description: Your cart is empty — the order service refuses a confirmation on it. Add items from browse first.

signedOut.title: Sign in to check out
signedOut.description: Checkout confirms against your session on the order service. Sign in on your account, then reload.

unreachable.title: Checkout unavailable
unreachable.description: Checkout is served by the order API at {url}. It is not reachable right now ({reason}).

account.title: Account
account.unreachable: The account service at {url} is not reachable ({reason}).

auth.headline: Your Northwind account.
auth.lede: Sign in — or create one — to keep a cart and place orders.
auth.signInIntro: Sign in with your email and password.
auth.registerIntro: One email and a password is the whole of it.
auth.passwordHint: Choose a password — this demo stores it hashed locally.
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.refusal: That email and password did not open a session.
auth.taken: That email already has an account — sign in instead.
auth.invalid: Enter an email and a password to continue.
auth.unavailable: The account service could not be reached ({reason}).

ordersSignedOut.title: Sign in to see orders
ordersSignedOut.description: Orders belong to a signed-in account; nobody is signed in here.

ordersUnreachable.title: No order status to show
ordersUnreachable.description: The account service at {url} is not reachable ({reason}).

ordersEmpty.title: No orders yet
ordersEmpty.description: The order service confirms this account has placed none.

ordersBuyer.title: The order service confirms this account has placed orders.
ordersBuyer.description: A per-order list is not served yet — each checkout confirmation shows that order's id, total and payment.
